messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

It was absolutely mobbed because of the festival and the tattoo, clambering up and down the hills near enough killed both my mum and I ( my legs still aren't talking to me ) and it pelted it down from the heavens.

output.original_text: It was absolutely mobbed because of the festival and the tattoo, clambering up and down the hills near enough killed both my mum and I ( my legs still aren't talking to me ) and it pelted it down from the heavens.
output.joy: It was incredibly crowded because of the festival and the tattoo, clambering up and down the hills was exhausting for both my mum and me ( my legs are sore but it was so worth it! ) and it poured rain from the heavens, but we didn't let it dampen our spirits!
output.sadness: It was completely mobbed because of the festival and the tattoo, climbing up and down the hills left both my mum and me drained ( my legs really hurt and it feels like such a struggle ) and it rained heavily from the heavens, making everything feel so bleak.
output.fear: It was totally mobbed because of the festival and the tattoo, clambering up and down the hills was almost too much for both my mum and me ( I can’t believe how worn out we are ) and the rain pelted down from the heavens, making me worry about getting caught out in a storm.
output.anger: It was ridiculously mobbed because of the festival and the tattoo, and clambering up and down those hills was brutal for both my mum and me ( my legs are practically screaming! ) on top of that, it just had to rain heavily from the heavens!
output.surprise: It was shockingly mobbed because of the festival and the tattoo! Clambering up and down the hills was almost too much for both my mum and me ( I’m stunned at how sore my legs are! ) and out of nowhere, it started pelting down from the heavens!
output.disgust: It was disgustingly mobbed because of the festival and the tattoo, clambering up and down the hills nearly destroyed both my mum and me ( my legs are a mess and I can’t stand this pain! ) and it just had to pour down from the heavens, leaving everything drenched.
